6316.note_text: “Pattern” is used in legal metrology with the same meaning as “type”; in the entries below, only “type” is used.

6314.note_text: systematic examination and testing of the performance of one or more specimens of an identified type (pattern) of measuring instruments against documented requirements, the results of which are contained in the evaluation report, in order to determine whether the type may be approved [VIML, 2.5]
